none: PAS NLM-957EAA: Roman Coin: Nummus of Constantius II
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Copy nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), possibly Constantius II (322-361), Gloria Exercitus issue of 335-341, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Head possibly helmeted right. Obverse inscription: [CONST]ANTIVS[--]. Reverse description: Two soldiers with one standard between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 8.5mm, Weight: 0.61gms, die axis: 6
